visual_anatomy.title: A large monetisation headline makes the central verb a lavender rough-display tag and immediately narrows the stated lens to audience size.
visual_anatomy.layout: A stacked working reference begins with a follower-band by offer-type fit matrix, follows with a price grid, uses one wide inverse time-versus-volume strip, and ends with an audience-band by offer-type advice matrix.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title → choose a follower-count row → scan offered models for fit → move down to the stated charging table and time-volume trade-off → return to the matching audience row in the advice matrix.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large open title, hand-rendered emphasis, bold black section bands, compact column headers, and small tabular text designed for reference rather than narrative reading.
visual_anatomy.colour: Each offer column keeps a distinct pastel header and light table fill; black full-width bands break the long reference into four major decision sections.
visual_anatomy.surface: White ground, fine black grid rules, soft pastel cells, rounded gradient bars, directional arrows, and a simple tapered time-versus-volume diagram.
visual_anatomy.modules: Follower-band fit map, five-row price table, one directional trade-off model, and follower-band advice matrix.
visual_anatomy.density: Extremely high: it asks the reader to cross-reference multiple grids, so persistent row labels and repeated offer columns carry most of the cognitive load.

motion.observed_state_change: No temporal state: this is a static JPEG source asset.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Choose among several options by first locating their current operating band, then checking feasibility, economics, and next action in the same reference.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Segmented decision matrix with supporting economics and advice.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Keep a single segmentation variable persistent across the major modules, while each module answers one different decision question: fit, indicative economics, trade-off, and action.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when audience bands, price estimates, offer definitions, and recommendations have clear assumptions and provenance; never present rough commercial heuristics as universal facts.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the monetisation taxonomy, follower thresholds, price figures, offer categories, time-volume diagram, black section bands, pastel table columns, title tag, or claimed advice.

claim_boundary.note: The source contains follower thresholds, pricing figures, feasibility assertions, and recommendations. These are not independently verified and cannot serve as public benchmark data.
